categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production, research, and sales of silicon carbide (SiC) semiconductor materials, including conductive and semi-insulating SiC substrates. These materials are used in power electronics, microwave electronics, 5G communications, automotive electronics, and other semiconductor applications. The company also engages in the development and manufacturing of related equipment and provides technical consulting and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies including SiC single crystal growth equipment design, thermal field design, high-purity SiC powder synthesis, impurity and defect control during crystal growth, and ultra-precision substrate processing techniques such as multi-wire cutting, polishing, and cleaning. It has developed automated and intelligent manufacturing processes, including a smart factory in Shanghai with AI and digital optimization. The company also pioneers liquid phase methods for low-defect 8-inch SiC crystal growth and maintains a strong patent portfolio in these areas.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international power semiconductor manufacturers, automotive electronics companies, and 5G communication device makers. Notable clients are Infineon and Bosch, with over 50% of the global top ten power semiconductor companies as customers. The products serve end markets such as new energy vehicles, photovoltaic power generation, energy storage, charging stations, industrial control, and wireless communication.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jinan, Jining, and Shanghai. It has established R&D and sales centers in Japan and subsidiaries in Germany, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Japan, serving global markets. Overseas sales have significantly increased, reflecting international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a key manufacturer of silicon carbide substrates, which are foundational materials for downstream semiconductor device fabrication. It supplies substrates to wafer manufacturers and device makers in power electronics and RF applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity, especially for 8-inch conductive SiC substrates, advancing core technologies in crystal growth and defect control, and enhancing product quality and yield. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on large-diameter substrates, defect reduction, impurity control, and ultra-precision processing. It also emphasizes intellectual property development and collaborates with national innovation centers and industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of silicon carbide semiconductor substrates and related materials. The company follows a make-to-order production model and engages in long-term supply agreements with major customers. Additional income comes from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading SiC substrate manufacturers globally and the largest in China. It ranks among the top three worldwide in conductive SiC substrate market share, surpassing competitors like Coherent. It holds a strong position in both conductive and semi-insulating SiC substrates, with recognized technology and scale advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.25 billion, nearly tripling from the previous year, driven by increased production and market demand. Although still reporting a net loss, the loss narrowed significantly compared to 2022. Total assets reached RMB 6.9 billion, an 18% increase year-over-year, reflecting ongoing capacity expansion and investment in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable, and large-diameter SiC substrates with advanced defect control and electrical performance, enabling superior device performance in high-voltage, high-frequency, and high-temperature applications. Its smart manufacturing capabilities and comprehensive technology stack provide customers with reliable supply and cost-effective solutions, supporting the rapid growth of new energy and communication sectors.
